description: Randomly generate a one-week menu (7 days by default, with breakfast / lunch / dinner every day) from a self-contained dish library. Picks dishes at random, avoids repeating the same dish within the same meal slot across the week when the pool allows, prints a readable Markdown or plain-text menu, and is reproducible through a --seed flag. Implemented with the Python 3 standard library only; it does not call the Huawei Cloud CLI, any Huawei Cloud SDK, or any REST API, and it touches no cloud resource. Triggers include: "生成一周菜单", "随机生成菜单", "一周食谱", "规划一周饮食", "帮我排一周菜谱", "weekly menu", "random menu", "meal plan", "weekly meal planner".
